_about: Play Data safety answers. Build the importable CSV with: node Docs_UNI_SIM/store-kit/data-safety.mjs Universal_Apps/Universal_Images/store-assets/data-safety.json Universal_Apps/Universal_Images/store-assets/out/play/data-safety.csv. PREPARED 2026-11-21, NOT YET IMPORTED: the app is not on Play yet; answer Data safety with this file at its first Play release, with a build that includes the 2026-11-21 phone change (signInInTune: false). Updated for the phone app recognising the suite sign-in (2026-11-21); it was 'nothing collected' from 2026-10-20 (login-free first iteration, Docs_UNI_SIM/login-free-plan.md). It still has NO sign-in of its own and creates no accounts (src/main.tsx `noAccounts: true` + `signInInTune: !PHONE`): no Sign in, no account screens, no name or email shown, no 'session.opened' event (no <UsageTracker />), hence PSL_ACM_NONE. But when the phone already holds a UNI·SIM session made by another suite app (Android's shared suite sign-in), the SDK reads and follows it: User IDs (optional; App functionality) is the account id that keys the reads and writes; Other actions (optional; App functionality) is Tune this app's choices kept with the account in user_app_prefs: this app's colour scheme and language in the 'tune:images' row (the SDK's TuneSync), and the suite-wide colour scheme and language in the 'suite' row (with the list of suite apps the account has used). Optional = only for someone already signed in elsewhere. Name and Email are not collected: the phone app shows neither and sends neither. Unchanged: opening, resizing, cropping, converting, reading and stripping metadata, blurring faces and removing backgrounds happen on the device (the face and background models are downloaded from public CDNs; no picture or user data goes with the request); the online backup that used to upload an edited picture is gone, the backup is a file the user keeps; no usage count (the suite user count, an install id, was retired in @unisim/sdk 0.187.0, and the anonymous daily open count is off under noAccounts). Mirrors ios/App/App/PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy and PRIVACY.md.
